evidence_quote: We examined the association between computed tomography (CT)-measured trabecular attenuation at the first lumbar vertebra (L1 CT-attenuation), bone mineral density (BMD), and osteoporosis in patients on hemodialysis.
rationale: The study evaluates CT-based osteoporosis screening in patients on hemodialysis. It does not address cancer biology, tumor progression, tumor biomarkers, or cancer treatments.
